## Description

`opencode` CLI (installed as `opencode-ai`) fails on every invocation — even `opencode --version` — with:

\`\`\`
EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/home/sandbox/.config/opencode'
    path: \"/home/sandbox/.config/opencode\",
 syscall: \"mkdir\",
   errno: -13,
    code: \"EACCES\"
\`\`\`

Same root-cause shape as #245 / PR #246 (\`fix: chown .local and .local/share so opencode can create .local/state\`), but on a different sibling parent. That fix covered \`~/.local\` and \`~/.local/share\`. opencode also writes config under \`~/.config/opencode/\`, and that fix missed this parent.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. \`make destroy && make sandbox\`
2. \`make shell\`
3. \`opencode --version\`

## Expected Behavior

Prints the opencode version, no errors. \`~/.config/opencode/\` gets created on first write, owned by \`sandbox:sandbox\`.

## Actual Behavior

EACCES on \`mkdir /home/sandbox/.config/opencode\`. \`/home/sandbox/.config\` has mode 755o and \`root:root\` owns it. Docker auto-creates that path for the \`gh-config:/home/sandbox/.config/gh\` named-volume mount in \`.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml:58\`. Nothing in \`entrypoint.sh\` chowns the parent.

## Root cause

\`\`\`
$ ls -lad /home/sandbox/.config
drwxr-xr-x 3 root root 4096 May  3 21:12 /home/sandbox/.config
\`\`\`

The recursive chown loop at \`.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh:21-38\` chowns \`.config/gh\` (the volume target) but not the parent \`.config\`. The non-recursive loop at \`.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh:45-49\` covers \`.local\` and \`.local/share\` only.

## Fix

Extend the existing non-recursive chown loop in \`.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh\` to also include \`/home/sandbox/.config\`. Non-recursive matches the precedent for \`.local\` / \`.local/share\` and preserves the contents of \`.config/gh\` untouched.

## Environment

- **Sandbox image**: \`ghcr.io/ryaneggz/openharness\` (current development)
- **Affected CLI**: \`opencode-ai\` (any version)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] \`opencode --version\` succeeds inside a fresh sandbox
- [ ] \`/home/sandbox/.config\` is owned by \`sandbox:sandbox\` after entrypoint runs
- [ ] \`gh\` flow still works (\`gh auth status\`, \`/home/sandbox/.config/gh\` contents intact)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry under \`[Unreleased] / Fixed\`
- [ ] PR targets \`development\`
